title: Segmenting Growth of Endothelial Cells in 6-Well Plates on an Orbital Shaker for Mechanobiological Studies
protocol: Fabricate the stainless-steel module from grade 316 stainless steel using a CNC milling machine according to the provided engineering drawing.
Prepare a 3D CAD model of the PDMS mold using SolidWorks based on the provided engineering drawing.
Export the CAD model as an STL file and import it into Cura 2.6.2.
Slice the model with a print speed of 50 mm/s and infill density of 60%.
Export the sliced model as a G-code file.
Upload the G-code to an Ultimaker2 3D printer for printing using PLA material.
Mix PDMS base and curing agent in a ratio of 90.9% base to 9.1% curing agent.
Pour approximately 2.6 mL of the mixed solution into the 3D printed mold.
Remove bubbles from the mixture in a vacuum degassing chamber.
Cure the PDMS mixture for 1 hour at 80 °C.
Allow the cured PDMS ring to cool to room temperature before carefully removing it from the mold.
Weigh out 5 g of Pluronic F-127 and pour it into a glass bottle.
Add 100 mL of sterile water to the glass bottle containing Pluronic F-127.
Submerge all Pluronic F-127 powder in water.
Close the cap and autoclave using a liquid sterilisation cycle program.
Let the solution cool to room temperature before use.
Add 10 mL of 5% Pluronic F-127 solution to 40 mL of autoclaved sterile water.
Perform the dilution in a biosafety cabinet hood.
Store both 1% and 5% Pluronic F-127 at room temperature.
Heat 800 mL of phosphate-buffered saline (PBS) to 60 °C whilst stirring.
Weigh 40 g of PFA powder and add it to the warm PBS solution.
Add 1 M sodium hydroxide (NaOH) slowly dropwise into the PFA solution until the solution turns clear.
Adjust the pH of the PFA solution to approximately 7.4 with 1 M of hydrochloric acid (HCl).
Top up the solution to 1 L with 1X PBS.
Filter the PFA solution with 0.2 µm filters to remove any particulates.
Aliquot and freeze the PFA solution in a -20 °C freezer.
Add 50 µL of pure Triton-X into 50 mL of PBS.
Let it roll for 1 h at room temperature on a roller to dissolve.
Store 1% BSA at 4 °C for up to two weeks.
Autoclave stainless-steel module, PDMS ring, and tweezers before use.
Place the PDMS ring in a 6-well plate using tweezers.
Align the PDMS ring concentrically with the well using its external rim.
Place the stainless-steel module on top of the PDMS ring using tweezers.
Insert tips of internal retaining ring pliers into grip holes of retaining ring, squeeze holder to reduce diameter.
Fit retaining ring into 6-well and press firmly on stainless-steel module; release pliers to secure PDMS ring in well.
Add 1 mL of 5 µg/mL fibronectin into center or edge of the well through opening of PDMS ring and stainless-steel module.
Swirl plate to ensure fibronectin solution covers all region of interest.
Incubate for 30 min at 37 °C in humidified incubator under 95% air/5% CO2.
Remove fibronectin solution from well.
Wash twice with PBS.
Completely remove PBS from well.
Remove retaining ring, stainless-steel module, and PDMS ring from well.
Add 1.5 mL of 1% Pluronic F-127 into center or edge of the well.
Incubate for 1 h at room temperature to passivate uncoated surface.
Remove Pluronic F-127 solution from the well.
Wash the coated well three times with PBS.
Store the coated well at 4 °C for up to two weeks, covered with a layer of PBS if not used immediately.
Use HUVECs below passage 5 in the experiment.
Remove all culture medium and wash cells once with PBS.
Add 3 mL of 0.05% trypsin and incubate for 3 min at 37 °C in a humidified incubator under 95% air/5% CO2.
Gently tap the flask to dislodge the cells.
Transfer the solution to a 15 mL centrifuge tube.
Neutralize the trypsin using 6 mL of prewarmed culture medium (e.g., Lonza EGM-2).
Centrifuge at 200 x g for 5 min.
Remove the neutralized trypsin solution and resuspend cells with 1 mL of prewarmed culture medium.
Count the cells using a haemocytometer.
Seed 180k cells into a coated 6-well plate in 1.5 mL of prewarmed culture medium.
Shake the well plate laterally to ensure even distribution of cells.
Leave it in a 37 °C humidified incubator under 95% air/5% CO2 overnight.
Remove unattached cells and culture medium.
Replace with 2 mL of prewarmed culture medium.
Replace the medium with 1.9 mL of prewarmed culture medium (to achieve a height of 2 mm).
Place the plate on the platform of an orbital shaker in a humidified incubator under 95% air/5% CO2 and swirl it at 150 rpm for 3 days.
Wipe down the exterior surface of the orbital shaker using 70% ethanol before placing it into the incubator (optional).
Remove the plate from the incubator after 3 days of shear stress application.
Wash cells twice with PBS.
Fix the cells by adding 1.5 mL of 4% PFA into the well and incubate for 10 min at room temperature.
Remove the 4% PFA from the well and wash twice with PBS.
Permeabilize the cells by adding 0.1% Triton-X into the well and incubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Remove the 0.1% Triton-X solution from the well and add 1.5 mL of 1% BSA into the well for blocking.
Incubate the cells with 1% BSA for 1 h at room temperature.
Dilute rabbit anti-human ZO-1 antibody at a 1:200 dilution in 1% BSA.
Add 1.5 mL of diluted antibody into the well and incubate it with the cells overnight at 4 °C.
Remove the diluted antibody and wash cells three times with PBS.
Dilute Alexa Fluor 488-labelled goat anti-rabbit IgG secondary antibody at a 1:300 dilution in PBS.
Add 1.5 mL of diluted secondary antibody into the well and incubate it with the cells for 1 h at room temperature.
Remove the diluted secondary antibody and wash cells twice with PBS.
Dilute DRAQ5 at a dilution of 1:1000 in PBS.
Add 1.5 mL of diluted DRAQ5 into the well and incubate it with the cells for 15 min at room temperature to stain the cell nuclei.
Remove the diluted DRAQ5 and wash three times with PBS.
Perform a tile scan from the edge to the center of the well with a confocal microscope.
